category_specs.product_shampoo_specs.rationale: The product is positioned for dry/damaged hair repair and shine rather than a named scalp concern; ordinary balanced scalp route is the only supported production target.

category_specs.product_shampoo_specs.cle.rationale: Moderate: SLES at position 2 and CAPB at position 3 provide effective ordinary cleansing, while early dimethicone, keratin and later amodimethicone/cationic guar keep the complete architecture from reading as strong reset. Observed intensity: regular.

product.suitable_thicknesses.rationale: Ideal: coarse — Coarse hair is the best default fit for this high-conditioning/high-weight repair and shine profile. Conditional (not emitted): normal — The repair-care stack can help damaged normal hair, but high weight potential makes it situational rather than an ideal diameter-level default.

required_protocol_roles.rationale: Roles derived from reviewed buckets: shampoo_everyday.

research.properties.cleansingStrength.rationale: Moderate: SLES at position 2 and CAPB at position 3 provide effective ordinary cleansing, while early dimethicone, keratin and later amodimethicone/cationic guar keep the complete architecture from reading as strong reset.

research.properties.conditioningLevel.rationale: High: dimethicone at position 5, keratin, amodimethicone, cationic guar and lipid/waxy refatting clues create a substantial rinse-off repair-care system.

research.properties.dandruffSupport.rationale: Not supported: the complete canonical formula contains neither Piroctone Olamine nor Climbazole.

research.properties.focusPrimary.rationale: Repair: the revealed product positioning targets dry, damaged hair and liquid keratin, and the formula has a compatible silicone, keratin and cationic-polymer repair-care system.

research.properties.focusSecondary.rationale: Shine secondary: the source explicitly promises glossy hair, and the silicone/smoothing system provides an independent route beyond the keratin-led repair positioning.

research.properties.scalpComfortTarget.rationale: Not targeted: the product targets dry/damaged hair fiber repair, softness and shine, not sensitive, itchy, dry-feeling or uncomfortable scalp.

research.properties.usageRole.rationale: Regular: directions are standard wet-hair distribution, rinse-out and regular use; no daily/frequent, alternating, reset or treatment trigger is present.

research.properties.weightPotential.rationale: High: early dimethicone, amodimethicone, cationic guar, keratin and waxy/refatting clues create a persistent multi-route deposition system despite ordinary SLES/CAPB reset.
